scope: Independent verification of the three transition findings and two follow-on API repairs. No final integrated candidate, shared Timeline.submit or scheduler review.
resolved_findings: Defining chord tones are retained before voice-path optimization; all 216 prepared entries remain feasible.
Every default acknowledgement explicitly carries its first chord's third and seventh.
Signed pitch steps preserve octave history; folding occurs when the register boundary requires it.
In-memory clipped sustains retain source identity, clipped timing and independent fields across successive programs.
Integration guidance documents current-event/signed-step arguments and source-plus-history reconstruction after serialization.

canonical_pitch_digest.serialization: UTF-8 JSON, no BOM and no trailing newline, no whitespace separators. Outer array contains all entries sorted lexicographically by ASCII entry.key. Each row is [entry.key, [[bass, harmony0, harmony1, harmony2], ...]]; slot order is the original table order. Integers use ordinary base-10 JSON notation. No metadata is included.
canonical_pitch_digest.python_equivalent: sha256(json.dumps([[e.key,[list(s.pitches) for s in e.slots]] for e in sorted(entries.values(),key=lambda e:e.key)],separators=(',',':')).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()

evidence_provenance.modification: The independent sequential-fragment probe extends one harmony-0 fixture note to 9 seconds / 13824 ticks in memory only.
evidence_provenance.timing: Analytic scene intervals only; no accepted-control, browser scheduler, detector, acoustic or audiovisual measurement.

residual_limitations: This closes the identified node 05 implementation defects only; it is not node 05 end-to-end GO or final node 08 approval.
WeakMap fragment identity is in-memory only. Serialized fragments are deliberately rejected as prepared source events; exports must be rebuilt from the original score and recorded program history.
The offline preview is TransitionPreview data and does not validate the shared Timeline.submit path or scheduling latency.
No human listening, physical scene acceptance, live device performance, acoustic onset or measured audiovisual timing was evaluated.
No complete unit suite, build or typecheck was rerun by this independent review; those reported author/coordinator results are outside this evidence.

commands.input: Inline independent read-only audit: enumerate all 216 entries, check defining tones/table pitch membership/upper-voice movement, calculate canonical pitch digest, run the Node probe, verify updated guidance and compare file SHA-256 snapshots before and after.

Inline independent assertions: cross-language digest, all 72 default dyads, six +2 then six -2 steps, upper-bound fold, two sequential +2 overlays on a 9-second sustain, contiguous coverage, independent fields and documented serialized-fragment rejection.

resource_teardown: Both foreground probes returned exit 0. No server, browser, container, watcher or persistent task-owned job was started.
